The proof differentiates the finite product law of the truncated volume (finite-profile Russo formula, 7WIO), double counts by transitivity and bounds the merge term by conditioning on the root cluster.

The proof differentiates in finite exhausting sets (7WIO), passes to the limit by dominated convergence, and repeats the finite merge and conditioning argument after a mass transport supplied by the hypothesis.

The proof justifies the derivative by finite-volume differentiation (7WIO) and dominated exhaustion, uses mass transport for the factor-three identity, and applies the Harris inequality (X5SS) to truncations for the lower bound.
The proof sums cluster powers over V, differentiates the finite product law with the edge forced closed (7WIO), and bounds the two-cluster term by conditioning on the root cluster.

The proof differentiates in finite induced subgraphs (7WIO), dominates by Hoelder and mass transport, and reruns the symmetrisation and conditioning steps of D7A5 and C9Y8 rather than applying their statements.
The proof reuses dominated finite-volume differentiation (7WIO), bounds outside clusters by conditioning, and gets the lower bounds from Harris association (X5SS) minus the same-cluster contribution.
The proof inserts into the countable moment hierarchy (09EI) two-sided bounds on each two-cluster term from conditioning and Harris association (X5SS).

The proof bounds the ghost transform above using mesoscopic negligibility and below by Jensen under size bias, then converts transform bounds to tail bounds by hand; it invokes no other wiki assertion.

The proof combines localized damping bounds (0WAE), moment-deficit bounds (NJF3), the quantile bound (LQ6Y) and the all-scale quantile theorem (NS0Q), feeds D7A5 and 6H7C into the negligibility theorem (KKGL), and applies the full-tail transfer (ZWQ3) with the ghost comparison from C4E9 and BEJT.
